title: Vesuvius quiet since 1948 and accumulating energy

tellings.quote: And from 1948 this volcano is not smoking anymore. So, it is accumulating energy.

plain: Mount Vesuvius, the volcano above Naples, is said to have stopped smoking in 1948 and to have been building up energy ever since. A researcher named Filippo Biondi, known for scanning beneath the Egyptian pyramids, tells Michels this without naming a source. If true, the long silence would be a sign of a larger eruption to come.
